name: astra-runtime-manager
description: Manage an experimental, version-pinned Astra runtime patch for Codex on Apple Silicon macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Set up, inspect, launch, and remove the Astra runtime patch.
interface.longDescription: Manage the separate experimental runtime without replacing the original Codex app. Requires the pinned Codex release and Apple Silicon macOS. A restart is required for activation; token savings are unmeasured.
defaultPrompt: Set up the Astra runtime patch.
Restore normal Codex and remove the managed runtime.
